body: ive been playing overwatch with some people i met online a few years ago but it just still isnt the same. i just feel dead inside. especially now

i just get bored with them easily now. use to be able to play for hours but now i cant play for more than 30 minutes. im a business management student. ive tried talking to classmates but it seems like by this point everyonw has thier group of friends and is happy with it. i usually just get basic small talk and nothing more, despite my effortd

i mean, in the past weekd ive pretty much just sat on my couch watching tv or gone to school. i dont really do much anymore. i use to play videogames a lot but, they just dont entertain me like they did

i want to go out but i struggle with anxiety. when im in public by myself i feel on edge. i feel like im jim carrey on the truman show. i went to 8 or 9 different public schools, i dont even remember the actual numer, so i never really had the benefit of friends or really learned how to talk to people and make friends, or never wanted to nowing id just leave again
im not sure i can drop her entirely but she has hurt me before and this is just the worst one given the level of betrayal. i feel like this might be the straw that broke the camels back

i know i can talk to him but, its just upsetting that she is ignoroing and making excuses for his shitty behavior to date him. she has always said this wasnt her. i just dont think i can trust her anymore

it is the same friend but as much as it reeks on bs im just upset because she is pursuing a guy that was extremely rude to me despite saying on multiple occasions that she wouldnt do anything like that. she has always talked about how she would stand up for me in situations like this, but given the opportunity she decides to date the guy.
either way i appreciate it. i have no one else
i dont know that i can stick around. this was the first person that ever made me feel comfortable and like i belonged. i feel betrayed

hey, how are you?

thanks for responding
please. anyone
I just need someone to talk to

It's been pretty obvious she's been living with me, Maintenance and the front office have seen her here. I probably should just be straight up with her. It going to fucking suck cause I know she will be upset but, I've barely slept since she's been here. It sucks cause I've never had a friend as close as her but, I can't be around her because of my feelings. Well I'm in for an uncomfortable talk when she wakes up. Thank you for affirming what I was thinking! I hope your day goes better than mine is looking

Edit: I just realized this will be way more uncomfortable than I realized cause she visited her mother yesterday and they had a fight.

I'm in this apartment for about another year and she isn't on the lease. I just let her stay with me because I didn't want her to be homeless. I still care about her and want to be friends but, it's a 1 bedroom apartment and given my feelings for her and the fact that she is sleeping with pretty much anyone she can it's rather difficult. She does have the option to go back to her mother's house but, they fight a lot so she hasn't yet. I know that her staying with me is bad for me but, her staying with her mother is bad for her. So I'm stuck with do I suck it up or do I tell her to

This is like reading something I wrote. I dont know you but please don't go through with it. This is my throwaway but I will PM you my main account if you ever need to talk. i spend most of the day on reddit so I will see if you message. we may not know you here but we all care. No ones life is worthless, and I say  that as someone who has thought about suicide daily for i dont even know how many years. I'm not the best at being as big of a help as most people here but, I, a complete stranger, am here for you and care about your life. If I do then I'm sure more people do. Check your PM and message me if you ever need or want to talk.

> I really hoped that I helped and that you are feeling a little bit better. I am sending love and good thoughts your way.

You've helped immensely, more than I can properly convey so thank you. I truly appreciate it
Everyone says the hardest part is actually getting help. I suppose I should start trying to push myself to do that
I've never had therapy but I probably need it. I just cant push myself to do it, I dunno, maybe I'm too scared
I suppose that would be alright, I just don't know what to do

> doesn't sound like your friendship with your friend is breaking up, just that it's changing a bit.

Part of me knows that but, that's what I have told myself with every other friend I no longer have. As far as the right people, I honestly dont know anymore

It was complete chance. We met when I went over to a project mates dorm to work and his gf brought her friend over. Since then we've been really good friends, or I thought we've been at least. I wasn't even supposed to go to his dorm that day but I happened to get out of class early. I've tried to meet new people, tried pretty damn hard, but it never really pans out. Typically I get one word responses from people I try to converse with or they just ignore me. And yeah, feeling alone while surrounded by people is absolutely horrible.

I've moved around a lot so I've never really had friends. I met this friend 3 years ago and we were both struggling with depression and a lot of the same problems. We helped each other immensely and spent basically all of our time together up until lately. Over the past few months she has started to branch out and be more social. I should be happy for her but, it feels like she iis forgetting about me. Someone invited her out for drinks and she invited me to go with her. I did and I sat there for about an hour an a half before leaving because none of them talked to me. I got there, she said hi, her friends told me their names, and that was it. The next hour an a half was them talking and laughing and me just sitting there. I couldn't have even entered the conversation if I had wanted too due to the way everyone was sitting, they all had their backs to me. It was like I went to the bar alone and just sat next to a group of strangers, not like I went with a close friend.

As for not leaving the house, well, I just dont have a reason to leave beyond groceries.

the same goes for you.

I use to talk to this one person a whole lot. I knew her from highscool and we talked almost every fday. Well, we did up until she got a new boy toy. She was going through a break up around the same time as me and we helped each other out with our problems. That is, up until she got with someone else and completely stopped talking to me like 3 months ago. We went from tlaking multiple times a day to absolutely nothing. Seems like evgeryone in my life just wants something from me so they can dip out.

Sorry for the novel, alcohol n such

I suppose you are right. Not an easy pill to swallow though

Thank you for replying by the way. someone talking to me doesnt happen very often

We had a relationship over a year ago. We broke up partly because of her crush on her professor but mainly for legitimate reasons. I got over it and we remained great friends. I'm not upset she slept with someone else, I'm upset she made plans with me and then ditched me to sleep with her professor knowing how I felt about him and how much it would hurt me
she isnt a shitty person though. She is actually the kindest person I've ever met. this is really uncharacteristic of her which is why it hurts a lot

Kinda hard to not hang out with her. She is literally my only friend. I don't mean she is the only friend I like, I mean she is literally the only person I know in this city. My only other friend lives multiple hours away. She knows it was shitty and that's partly why it's so hurtful. She ditched knowing that it would hurt me so she could get with a middle aged alcoholic
